name: statefall
description: Headless simulation tests and release tooling for Statefall

scripts.syntax: node tools/check-game-syntax.js && node --check playwright.config.js && node --check playwright.wordpress.config.js && node --check tools/package-zip.js && node --check tools/build-release.js && node --check tools/build-plugin.js && node --check tools/build-previous-plugin.js && node --check tests/build-package-fixtures.js && npm run syntax:prototype
scripts.test: npm run test:harness-hardening && npm run test:help-contract && npm run test:browser-server && npm run test:security && npm run test:seeded-order && npm run test:replaycheck && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:restart && npm run determinism
scripts.test:restart: node tests/restart-replay.js standard && node tests/restart-replay.js fog && node tests/restart-replay.js garrisons
scripts.test:visual:windows: npm run test:visual:map:windows && npm run test:visual:prototype:windows
scripts.verify:browser: npm run test:browser && npm run test:desktop-scale && npm run test:prototype
scripts.build:game: vite build && node tools/build-howto.js dist/howto && node tools/build-flags.js dist/flags.js && node tools/finalize-game-build.js
scripts.build:artifacts: npm run build:release && node tools/build-plugin.js && node tools/build-previous-plugin.js && node tests/build-package-fixtures.js
scripts.verify:artifacts: npm run build:artifacts && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File sandbox/verify-artifacts.ps1
scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run verify:browser
scripts.release:assets: node tools/build-howto.js pkg/howto && node tools/build-flags.js pkg/flags.js
